_purpose: Pre-registration. Every strategy declares its hypothesis and its pass/fail bar BEFORE it accumulates evidence. evidence.js judges against this file, so a result can never be rationalised after the fact. Editing a hypothesis after seeing results is the one thing that invalidates this lab.
_bar: A strategy is only 'proven' if it beats the entry-price-implied expectation with p < 0.0026 (Bonferroni across ~19 concurrent tests) on event-clustered errors, OR shows positive closing-line value at the same corrected threshold.

mid_momentum.hypothesis: Buying the rising side in 30-70c markets beats the price because payoffs are symmetric there.
mid_momentum.predicts: positive extra wins vs entry-price expectation
mid_momentum.note: Peaked at an apparent +$1,475 realized which was a reporting artifact; true peak equity +$754. Currently indistinguishable from the price.

mm_sports.hypothesis: The momentum signal works in sports specifically, where the crowd reacts to team news.
mm_sports.predicts: positive extra wins, larger than mid_momentum
mm_sports.note: Best in lab but p=0.21 — fails correction. Needs ~1,000+ bets at the current effect size.

mm_tight.hypothesis: Cutting the sub-45c band improves mid_momentum.
mm_tight.status: FAILED — walk-forward showed the cut band was profitable out-of-sample; this variant underperforms its parent.

mm_slow.hypothesis: The edge is slow news, so 2+ day markets should be better.

mm_strong.hypothesis: A larger move (>=8c) is a stronger signal.

mm_cheap.hypothesis: The edge is masked by execution cost; restricting to <=2c spreads should reveal it.
mm_cheap.predicts: positive extra wins where mid_momentum has none

copy_top.hypothesis: Mirroring top leaderboard wallets' pregame buys captures their edge.
copy_top.status: FAILED — negative extra wins; profit came from payoff structure, not selection.

copy_pro.hypothesis: Filtered wallets, freshness limits and no-chasing improve copy trading.

copy_month.hypothesis: In-form (monthly leaderboard) traders are better to copy than all-time.

whale_fade.hypothesis: Control for copy_top — if copying works, fading must lose.

momentum.hypothesis: Price continuation exists at any price level.

fade_longshot.hypothesis: Longshots are systematically overpriced, so selling them wins.
fade_longshot.note: 97% win rate but only +0.4 wins above expectation — the win rate is an artifact of price, not skill.

super.hypothesis: Requiring two agreeing signals (whale + momentum) filters noise.

ai_judge.hypothesis: A local LLM's probability estimate can find >4c mispricings.
ai_judge.note: Model mostly agrees with the market, so it rarely bets — honest but slow to accumulate evidence.

maker_sports.hypothesis: STRUCTURAL, not predictive: mm_sports' signal loses ~0.6c per bet crossing the spread. Posting passively at the bid should convert that cost into a saving, so the same signal should outperform its taker twin by roughly the spread — IF fills are not adversely selected.
maker_sports.predicts: beats mm_sports by ~1c per bet; fill rate above 30%

mm_sports_v2.hypothesis: REPLICATION. Byte-identical to mm_sports, started fresh 2026-08-05 with no history. If mm_sports' +6.2 extra wins reflect a real edge, this copy should show the same effect on entirely new bets. If it was luck, this copy will drift to zero.
mm_sports_v2.predicts: positive extra wins of similar magnitude to the parent (~+2.3% ROI after fees)
mm_sports_v2.note: Verified behaviourally identical to the parent across 504 decision cases before launch. Rule is frozen — editing it voids the replication.

mid_momentum_v2.predicts: positive extra wins similar to the parent

mm_cheap_v2.hypothesis: REPLICATION of mm_cheap, fresh start 2026-08-05. The parent's 32% ROI rests on 24 bets, so this is the most likely of the three to be pure noise.
mm_cheap_v2.predicts: positive extra wins; expected to be the weakest replication

maker_flat.hypothesis: STRUCTURAL, no forecasting at all: simply providing liquidity on liquid two-sided markets captures the spread. If this is profitable, edge exists without predicting anything.
maker_flat.predicts: positive P&L with roughly random win rate; fill rate above 30%
maker_flat.note: The key test of Door 2. Adverse selection is the expected failure mode: fills cluster on the side about to be wrong.
